facebook.caption:
5,457 reviews. 4.7 stars. And somehow Mövenpick Resort Waverly Phu Quoc still flies under the radar compared to the southern resort strip.

Ông Lang side of the island. Quieter beach. Two restaurants, a full spa, and a pool that actually has space in it.

If you want the posh resort experience without the Phú Quốc crowds, this is the move.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
